messages:
Asha: Quick postmortem follow-up from the Sierra disruption — customer reported brief cross-tenant reachability after an on-prem gateway switchover. Root cause looks like a BGP attribute rewrite bug in our import pipeline that dropped the community tag for a small set of prefixes.

Asha: I sketched action items in the postmortem doc. TL;DR: ownership for fixes, short-term mitigations for Sierra, and a scheduled detection job to catch repeats.

Diego: I'll own the code fix in the import-filter path (owner: Diego, due 2026-04-04). Plan: ensure communities and origin ASN are preserved & add a regression unit test that replays the gateway switchover trace.

Noah: I'll take the canary fencing and rollout plan (owner: Noah, due 2026-04-06). Proposal: per-cluster strict-mode flag & automatic rollback if overlap alerts fire during rollout. Canary window 24h.

Priya: I'll run a retrospective audit across Dedicated tenants for any dropped community tags in the last 90 days (owner: Priya, due 2026-04-03). Deliverable: CSV of affected prefixes + tenant map and a proposed alert rule.

Asha: Short-term mitigation for Sierra: Diego, can you do an emergency patch to re-insert missing community tags from the last known good snapshot? It would be gated and reversible.

Diego: I can build a throttled rewriter that only touches prefixes from Sierra's cluster; low blast radius. Will open hotfix PR today and coordinate with Noah for staged deploy.

Noah: For rollout we should coordinate with Dedicated ops to schedule off-peak apply. Also adding a pre-check step that validates community preservation on a dry-run before commit.

Priya: Audit note: while scanning logs I found two other clusters with intermittent community drops, but they didn't cause reachability errors. I'll include severity tags in the report.

Asha: For recurring detection: add a metric for community-loss-rate per cluster and an alert when it exceeds 0.1% of imported prefixes in a 1h window. Priya, can you prototype?

Priya: Yes — prototype by Wed. I'll put thresholds in the postmortem doc and link to Optimize's anomaly recipes.

Diego: One extra defensive change: make the import-filter idempotent and add a fast path that refuses imports missing the community + origin ASN tuple. That will stop future silent drops.

Noah: Also proposing a small onprem harness test that performs a control-plane switch while we inject malformed advertisements to confirm controller behavior. Will coordinate with Diego.

eng-sre-bot: Created ticket INC-23512: "Sierra: import-filter community-preserve hotfix + audit" and added assignees.

Asha: Customer comms plan: short notification to Sierra explaining root cause & mitigation timeline, include rollback plan and offer a joint validation window. I'll draft the message and share with support/legal.

Diego: ack, starting work on hotfix today. Will link PR to INC-23512.

Priya: ack, audit job started.

Noah: ack, will block 3h in the deploy window calendar for canary coordination.

Asha: Great — I'll run a 20m owners sync tomorrow morning to check progress. Please update INC-23512 with status and paste any artefacts there.
